type: sudo apt-get update -qq; sudo apt-get install -y -qq auditd 2>&1 | tail -3
sudo systemctl start auditd; sudo auditctl -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S kill -S tkill -S tgkill -S pidfd_send_signal -k q61kill; sudo auditctl -l

sudo sh -c 'P=/dev/virtio-ports/hscl.qa; L(){ echo "Q61| $*" >$P; }; L rules; auditctl -l >$P 2>&1; for i in $(seq 1 12); do setsid /usr/bin/calamares-launch-normal >/tmp/o.$i 2>&1 & sleep 16; s=$(ps -o sid= -C calamares|head -1|tr -d " "); L "start $i alive=$(pgrep -cx calamares) out=$(wc -c </tmp/o.$i)"; [ -n "$s" ] && { kill -15 -$s; sleep 4; kill -9 -$s 2>/dev/null; }; sleep 3; done; L audit; ausearch -k q61kill 2>&1|tail -120 >$P; L end'
